title: AADP Evidence Module v1.0 — Source
description: Component schema (not a top-level module document kind). Describes where an evidence document came from — a location OUTSIDE AADP that this module never fetches (specification.md §13). `title` and `publisher.name` are untrusted free text. `access` is presentation metadata ONLY: it is a producer assertion about the source behind `url`, it grants no access, and it MUST NOT take part in any traversal, authorization or conformance decision (specification.md §12, ADR-0010 §8) — authorization of the evidence resource itself is decided by core/Relations authorization and the manifest `security` declaration.
